scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hono,web -c green,blue "npm --workspace=backend run dev" "wait-on -t 90000 http-get://localhost:3470/health && npm --workspace=frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:db: (createdb ai-fluence-test 2>/dev/null || true) && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://localhost:5432/ai-fluence-test?client_min_messages=warning npm --workspace=backend run db:migrate
scripts.dev:test: concurrently -k -n hono-test,web-test -c green,blue "npm --workspace=backend run dev:test" "wait-on -t 90000 http-get://localhost:3471/health && npm --workspace=frontend run dev:test"
scripts.test:full: npm run test:db && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:full
